what_works: Champagne house uses gold-on-charcoal palette with editorial-magazine pacing — the page rewards a slow scroll. Big serif numerals as section anchors give the build a 'chapter' feel that signals premium price tier.
what_does_not_translate: WebGL fresco animation belongs to a $40K agency build — borrow the chapter-numeral structure and the palette, not the WebGL.
type_observations: High-contrast serif display (Didot family) for chapter numbers, neutral sans for body — the contrast between thin serif hairlines and grounded sans is the luxury cue.
